bugs_found_and_fixed.summary: A customer with no qualifying discount could never be sent a payment link
A reschedule created a second calendar event instead of patching the first
The welcome message was suppressed because ownership transferred before the outbox flushed
Cancellation notices were silently swallowed by the terminal-state block
tutor_ref was erased between turns by a None derived from an absent demo row
Commands accepted a caller-supplied tutor_ref, bypassing the snapshot check
Discount bands matched on any trigger rather than all, overpaying every price-sensitive customer by ~5%
'my son is in class 10' parsed as a demo time
A Google failure left the slot hold in place for its full TTL
Every outbound message was blocked: the output guard counted any URL as PII
NextStep.ADDRESS_OBJECTIONS did not exist; the offline stub would raise AttributeError
A conference with 2+ participants asserted no attendance, losing discount eligibility
The invisible-character detector held literal bidi characters in source
Coverage omit paths were stale and matched nothing
